query:
SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE workspace_id <> ALL($3::text[])) as count,
                       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE workspace_id = ANY($3::text[])) as excluded_count,
                       MIN(scheduled_for) FILTER (WHERE workspace_id <> ALL($3::text[])) as oldest_job
                FROM v2_job_queue
                WHERE tag = $1
                  AND scheduled_for <= NOW() - $2::interval
                  AND running = false
